meta.title: DoD Instruction 1327.06 - Leave and Liberty Policy and Procedures
meta.subject: LEAVE AND LIBERTY POLICY AND PROCEDURES

section.heading: DoD Instruction 1327.06, Leave and Liberty Policy and Procedures, June 16, 2009, incorporating Change 3

correction.against: USLM User Guide section 12.2, Referencing Model
correction.change: normalize_identifiers.py - period replaced with underscore in every USLM path segment
the period is reserved in USLM for the manifestation suffix, so a segment such as mco/1050.3j is ambiguous against the published grammar
underscore is drawn from the RFC 3986 unreserved set, which the USLM 2.1 Review Guide already requires for version strings
document id, native number, and displayed text are unchanged
IDENTITY CHANGE - owner adjudication required under [ID2] before promotion out of staging
